## Problem to solve

What situation does the current skill handle poorly or not at all? Describe
the task an agent would face.

## Proposal

What should change, in which file? Keep the proposal consistent with the
existing method (five passes, depth tiers, motion ladder, hard rules).

## Alternatives considered

What other ways could this be addressed, including changing nothing?

## Honest scope check

- Does this addition require runtime dependencies? (Prefer none.)
- Could it make simple tasks heavier? (The depth-tier model should absorb it.)
- Have you checked that the behavior is not already covered in references/ or
  examples/?
